book.name: ROME
book.title: MUKAANA A POOLE KUNDAA BASI ROME

content: Mukriste li wu bákwulu mu litumu li Mikyene
Bandughu ba me mu kana, me kundaa baara ba basoolo Mikyene me ndi mu okabili. Be ka lisoolo o ti Mikyene mili a litumu ŋa yulu a mbwuru, mu matala mwohono ma ali nde mweẽ?

Mu obo, mukala li a munama ya mulumu a nde mu mikyene mi mabala mu matala mwohono maala mulumu a nde li mweẽ. Lo kala ti mulumu a nde kpi, mukaha ka afirisyili kunsa mikyene mi mabala mi miikabvughu nde munama ya mulumu a nde o.

Kala ti mu matala maala mulumu a nde li mweẽ, baghala mukimi firikie nde, baghala munde faana ofiri bukala mu kuulu nde aabvughu mbughu ya mukala a nganda-mbwuru. Lo kala ti mulumu a nde kpi, nde ka afirisyili kunsa Mikyene o. Mu obo, nde ka aabvughu mbughu ya mulumu a nganda-mbwuru o kala ti nde ayi mukala a baghala mukimi.

Mu obo, bandughu ba me mu kana, behe si bádzwi be mu mi mitala Mikyene mu kuulu be líili emo ya Kriste mu lipfu li nde. Mu bu, be lili baba ndaa mbwuru mukimi, munde wu áasighili ŋa kara li ba bápki, mu kuulu bihi-a-be likagyighili mandagha ma maakagwa Nzaami esee.

Mu kuulu, mu matala ma líli bihi-a-be kunsa litumu li musunu, bihi-a-be líili a dzyi li okasa masumu mu nzili a mikyene, ya dzyi lilo, líkasala mu manyuru ma bihi mwohono. Ya bihi-a-be líikasa mandagha ma maakabiri ku lipfu.

Lo mu matala ma, bihi-a-be ka lifirisyili kunsa litumu li Mikyene o. Ngu okala ti bihi-a-be lili bankana, ka mu litumu li likulu, lili Mikyene mi basono o. Lo bihi-a-be lili bankana mu litumu li linyaghara lili Mufulu Ngili.
Esala ki Mikyene

Bihi nki ndagha liilyele? Mikyene mili masumu? Si okala ka bunu! Lo yini a mu nzili a Mikyene me aansoolo masumu. Mu obo, me ka ákaansoolo sughu li mukolo o, kala ti Mikyene ka míkalyele o ti: «We ka sughu mukolo o.»
Mu obo, masumu bu mabagha mpeene, maaburu mu me mu nzili a mukyene, sughu li mukolo lili mawa-mawa. Mu kuulu, wene a Mikyene, masumu maakpi.
Mu matala ma makulu, me áandi mweẽ wene a Mikyene. Lo mikele bu migyi, masumu mabagha bumweẽ,
ya me, me aankpi. Mu obo, mukele wu aakabiri ku laama, aatsiini me ku lipfu.
Mu kuulu, mu mikele, masumu maabagha mpeene yi opfiri me, ya mu mye, masumu maadzwi me.
Obo me buulu, Mikyene mili mimi ngili ya mikele mili mimi ngili, mimi nsumu ya mi mibwe.
Mu obo, kundaa me bubwe ayi lipfu? Si okala ka bunu! Obo me bu oosuo lisumu maangu-efa e lo, lo liisalala bubwe mu obiri me mu lipfu. Mpaala mu mukele, lisumu limoŋono mu lileene li lo lwohono.
Nkana a mukyene a lisumu
Mu kuulu, bihi-a-be lisoolo ti Mikyene mili mufulu. Lo me, me ndi mbwuru wu li a nyuru yi musunu, wu bátyeghe kundaa masumu.
Mu kuulu, me ka ndi mu okabaghala mandagha ma ndi mu ogyighili me o. Ndagha yi ndzyi me, me ka ndi mu okagyighili yo o. Lo yi aangwene okadzyi me, me yi ndi mu okagyighili me.
Lo kala ti ndagha yi aakangyighili me ngu yi aangwene okadzyi me, me ndi bitsimi bimõ ya mikyene, mu olyele ti mye mili mi mibwe.
Mu matala ma, ka ofirisyili me meme ndi mu okagyighili mandagha mamo o, me lisumu li lili mu me li li mu okatumu me mo okagyighili.
Me nsoolo yo ti mu me ka oli a ndagha yimbwe o, ma mbaala ti munsa nyuru a me. Mu kuulu mu me, me nkughu okala a bitsimi bii osa bubwe, lo me ka ndi a mpini mu osa bo o.
Me ka aakansa bubwe bu aakandzyi me o, lo me aakansa bubi bu aangwene okadzyi me.
Kala ti me ngyighili ndagha yiili me ka ndzyi yo o, ka me ndi mu ofirikagyighili yo o, lo lisumu li lili mu me lili mu okagyighili yo.
Mu obo, me wu ndzyi osa bubwe me aabaghala mukyene wu: Ndagha yi nkughu me osa yina bubi.
Mu kuulu, munsa mukolo a me, me aankamono esee mu Mikyene mi Nzaami,
lo munsa nyuru a me yohono me aakamono mukyene mukimi wu aakadzwana ya munde wu li emo ya mayele ma me. Nde aakasa me nkana a mukyene a lisumu li lili mu nyuru a me.
Nyiĩ mu me! Nande akala aakwulu me mu nyuru yi, yi aakabiri me ku lipfu?
Matuono kundaa Nzaami mu Yiisu-Kriste Mfumu a bihi-a-be! Me mu obo, mu embwuru e me, me ndi nkana a Mikyene mi Nzaami, lo mu nyuru a me, me ndi nkana a mikyene mi lisumu.
